mentions.name: UN Project
mentions.description: A web app for exploring United Nations meetings by browsing transcripts, speeches, and voting records from the General Assembly and Security Council. It includes visualizations such as an animated voting bubble chart and a voting similarity map that shows each country's closest matches.
